newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg ups stake in Italy's Poretti.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg ups stake in Italy's Poretti.

text.p: Danish brewer Carlsberg said on Tuesday that it had increased its 50 percent shareholding in Italian beermaker Industrie Poretti S.p.A., to a controlling 75 percent.

A Carlsberg statement, which gave no financial details of the purchase, said that Poretti Chairman Aldo Bassetti would continue in his post "at least for one more election period" and senior management would not be changed.
Poretti produces Carlserg's Tuborg brand locally and imports and distributes the Carlsberg brand. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
